$comment: Machine-readable acceptance ledger (ТЗ 10/10 rev2 §22, §18.3). One entry per program milestone: status, requirement/evidence lists, blocking issues, waivers and the accepted commit. A milestone whose status is NOT 'accepted' must not be treated as a completed stage: downstream milestones may proceed only with evidence that this ledger records. No user consent, debug mode or high-risk grant can override a blocked requirement.

milestones.name: Этап 0 / Governance and safe baseline
requirements: ADR-0038 canonical Rust Kernel core adopted
AGENTS.md, README and architecture docs updated to the two-plane model
generated capability/status/host matrix wired into docs:check
honest desktop default (sidecar release / Kernel preview) + mode conflict policy
legacy feature freeze except security fixes and migration bridges
docs workflow single source tree (apps/docs mirrors docs/)
architecture exception registry with CI-enforced expiry (ARC-09)
PWA renamed to Remote/Installable Web Client, standalone-offline claim removed
compatibility authority rule: legacy MUST NOT expand native capability

milestones.name: Этап 1 / Security blockers
requirements: logical profile export (SEC-02: allowlist, no DB snapshot, no secrets)
SSRF-safe network broker with post-connect verification (SEC-03)
blockingIssues: P0: session SecretStore destroyed legacy plaintext on bootstrap (fixed in this milestone; verify portable/env flows end-to-end on packaged builds)
P0: plugin entrypoint inside signature/ escaped the signed digest (fixed: validatePackage + host-side defense-in-depth)
P0: WebSocket post-connect remoteAddress verification missing (undici WebSocket does not expose the connected socket; documented follow-up in socketHandles.ts)
P0: network broker TCP/proxy paths connect by hostname after checking a single DNS answer; verified-IP set not honored on every connect
P1: no global/per-plugin in-flight byte budget and decompressed-byte accounting for streaming bodies
P1: profile export reads tables without a snapshot transaction and exports unknown future columns of allowlisted tables
P1: legacy migrator does not yet carry personas/settings/branches/revisions/assets (Этап 4 follow-ups)

milestones.name: Этап 2 / Golden Kernel vertical slice
requirements: provider settings without secrets in DB
prompt pipeline: history, character, persona, lorebook, instruct, token budget
durable generation run/step model with tool-call loop, yield/resume and budgets
blockingIssues: golden scenario (ТЗ §17.2) is exercised as a kernel smoke, not yet as the full packaged E2E with tool-call/yield/resume fault injection — rename 'golden' to 'kernel smoke' in docs until the packaged golden E2E exists

milestones.name: Этап 3 / Data cutover
requirements: staged converter in the application flow
versioned roots, activation journal, rollback/safety retention
Windows bounded retry, activation_pending and restart-to-complete
upgrade drill on Windows with lock contention, macOS and Linux
blockingIssues: P0: the data-root lease is held only during prepare and released before commit — between the phases another process could start writing; the journal prevents corruption but single-writer is not guaranteed across the full migration lifecycle (documented design boundary for a follow-up)

milestones.name: Этап 4 / Full UI/API cutover
requirements: slice 1: personas and full lorebook CRUD (contract → application → adapter → UI → E2E → legacy route removal)
repository scan finds no production /api/v2 or legacyRaw calls
legacy Fastify no longer owns product data
evidence: lorebooks.crud (5 wire ops) + personas.crud (5 wire ops) kernel-side complete
wireBridge.ts lorebook/persona hooks route through the facade in kernel mode
wire corpus + remote-http host parity + kernel integration tests
check-ui-api --check OK (67 allowed sites, all with removal records)
blockingIssues: legacy /api/v2/lorebooks and /api/v2/personas route removal still pending (after parity)
entry-level lorebook nested CRUD has no per-entry wire contract yet (honest CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE in kernel mode)
character↔lorebook scoping not modeled in the kernel schema
chat.persona_id linkage and prompt {{user}} injection from the personas table not wired
